title: Security | Hark
text:
Sign Up
Your data is yours.
We never sell it.
We never advertise with it. You can always delete it.
Security at Hark

We didn't write a security policy. We built a set of promises — what we'll never do, what we'll always protect, and what you'll always be able to stop.

Epic Capability. Enterprise Security.

Protection
Transparency
Permissions
Balance
Basics
We guard your data like a bank
We never see your most sensitive data
Hark stores your most sensitive data in a vault.
Data is moved in an armored car.
(Passwords, credit card numbers, etc, are tokenized in our hands)
